entities.name: Zoning Code
entities.description: The official regulations and standards governing land use, zoning districts, and development within the city of Coral Gables.

entities.name: Parking Requirements
entities.description: Regulations specifying the number and type of parking spaces required for different land uses, including provisions for reductions near transit stops.

entities.name: Affordable Housing
entities.description: Housing units that are affordable to low- and moderate-income residents, with considerations for parking reductions near transit as per the Live Local Act.

entities.name: Live Local Act
entities.description: Florida legislation (Ch. 2023-17) that encourages local governments to consider reducing parking requirements for affordable housing near major transit stops.
